subject: Attack response matrix & supply-chain SBOM — Pioneer Health RFI
messages:
From: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@pioneerhealth.org>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: David Lin <dlin@pioneerhealth.org>, procure@pioneerhealth.org
Date: 2026-11-02T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Vendor RFI: vulnerability management, SBOM, pen test summary

Hi Grace,

Thanks for taking our RFI. Attached is the Pioneer vendor security worksheet (Pioneer_VM_RFI_v3.xlsx) — we need detailed answers for: SAST/DAST cadence and tooling, patching SLAs (for both infra and third-party libs), recent pen test executive summary, and an SBOM snapshot showing third-party components and licensing.

High-level priorities:
- Evidence of consistent static/dynamic testing in CI
- Clear patching/RCA SLAs for critical/high findings
- Third-party OSS inventory and risk scoring method
- Pen test scope and whether you run 3rd-party red teams

We have an internal deadline of 2026-11-15 to assemble responses for procurement. Would you be able to provide a consolidated technical packet and an attachment set by 2026-11-11? If possible, include a short table of expected remediation timelines by severity.

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a 30-minute call next week to walk through items.

Thanks,
Sophie Tran
Senior Security Analyst, Vendor Risk
Pioneer Health

Attachments: Pioneer_VM_RFI_v3.xlsx
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@pioneerhealth.org>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T11:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor RFI: vulnerability management, SBOM, pen test summary

Hi Sophie —

Thanks for the RFI and the worksheet. We can provide the consolidated packet by 2026-11-11. To set expectations up front: we’ll deliver an executive summary plus three evidence artifacts (VM playbook, SBOM snapshot, and pen-test executive summary).

Quick clarifying points so we return precisely what you need:
1) When you ask for SAST/DAST cadence, do you want pipeline-level evidence for each public repository, or a representative sample across our service repositories?
2) For patching SLAs, do you need separate SLAs for Redwood-managed infra versus customer-managed private deployments (we operate both models)?
3) For third-party OSS scoring: do you want our internal risk classification + CVE-driven severity, or the raw dependency list with CVE counts so your team can run its own analysis?

We’ve tentatively scheduled Rishi (Security Lead, Product) to assemble the technical attachments; Neha (solutions engineering) will collate the SBOM CSV. If a 30-minute sync is helpful, we have availability next Wednesday (2026-11-10) from 10:00–12:00 PT.

Regards,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@pioneerhealth.org>, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor RFI: vulnerability management, SBOM, pen test summary

Sophie / Grace —

Following up with the consolidated technical packet attached. Summary below and attachments include the evidence you requested.

What we are delivering (attachments):
- Redwood_VM_Playbook_v1.4.pdf — describes our vulnerability lifecycle (triage, owner assignment, fix windows, verification). Includes our incident escalation matrix and a sample remediation tracker.
- SBOM_snapshot_20261101.csv — BOM export for our public-service image fleet; includes package name, version, license, and CVE count at export time.
- PenTest-ExecSummary-2026-09.pdf — executive summary from our most recent external engagement (scope: hosted API + auth, no PHI handling elements).

Direct answers to your checklist:
- SAST/DAST:
  - SAST (static analysis) runs on every pull request via our CI (primary tooling: SonarQube + open-source linters); daily bulk scans against main branches.
  - DAST (dynamic) scheduled for weekly staging runs on critical entry points and prior to every major release (quarterly for full-app DAST). We also run targeted external DAST prior to production rollout for platform-level changes.
- Patch SLAs:
  - Critical (CVSS >=9 or active exploit): 72 hours to patch and deploy, 24 hours for emergency mitigation (WAF rules / config) if patch not immediately available.
  - High (CVSS 7-8.9): 14 calendar days.
  - Medium (CVSS 4-6.9): 30 calendar days.
  - Low: next maintenance window (documented).
  - Notes: for Dedicated/Private customers who manage their own runtime, we provide patch advisories and a supported remediation timeline; for Redwood-managed hosting we perform the patch and verify.
- Pen test:
  - We engage third-party testers annually (most recent: 2026-09) and on major architectural changes. Reports include severity, reproducible steps, remediation owner, and validation steps. We retain redacted executive summaries for sharing; full reports are available under NDA.
- SBOM & supply-chain:
  - We maintain per-image and per-service SBOMs, updated via automated SBOM generation during CI build. The CSV attached is a representative snapshot.
  - Dependency risk scoring: we combine CVE frequency, exploit maturity (proof-of-concept presence), and package popularity to produce an internal risk score. We will include the scoring column in a follow-up export if you prefer raw dependency CSV plus scores.

Additional notes:
- Vulnerability tracker: RDW-VC-4321 is our internal tracker for the last pen test remediation run — we can provide a redacted export.
- Evidence retention: audit logs, patch history, and testing artifacts are retained for 24 months for hosted customers; for Dedicated we can negotiate longer retention in contract.

Attachments: Redwood_VM_Playbook_v1.4.pdf; SBOM_snapshot_20261101.csv; PenTest-ExecSummary-2026-09.pdf

If you want, we can add the scoring column to the SBOM export and return it by 2026-11-11. Grace — we’ll need procurement language for exceptions on report sharing (NDA).

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Security Lead, Product
Redwood Inference
From: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@pioneerhealth.org>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: David Lin <dlin@pioneerhealth.org>
Date: 2026-11-11T08:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor RFI: vulnerability management, SBOM, pen test summary

Rishi / Grace —

This is exactly what we needed — thank you. A few follow-ups:
- Could you include the scoring column in the SBOM export (as you offered)? That will speed our internal risk scoring.
- Does Redwood have a public-facing list of maintained OSS components, or do you only provide exports on request?

We’re close to completing procurement approval and will follow up on NDA language for full pen test reports. If you can get the SBOM with scores by EOD 2026-11-11, that would be ideal.

Thanks again — Sophie
